verdict.rationale: PagerDuty Post-Incident Reviews are documented to help teams 'coordinate preventative follow-up actions', and the Scribe Agent records action items from incident calls. That covers capturing and coordinating follow-ups inside PagerDuty. There is no evidence that follow-up actions are tracked to completion or synced to an issue tracker; the 'Integrate with ITSM Tools' page title and the generic integrations count do not show action-item sync. Missing for 10: documented tracking of action-item status through to completion, documented two-way or one-way sync of PIR follow-ups to an issue tracker such as Jira, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering leader, follow-up actions from incidents are tracked to completion and sync to our issue tracker

citations.quote: help your team uncover systemic patterns, build chronological incident narratives, and coordinate preventative follow-up actions
Schedule a Scribe Agent to join incident calls and record key decisions, action items, and events once a conference bridge is available.
Teams can start PIRs directly from the incident detail page or Slack after resolving an incident
